BUG FOUND & FIXED: partner payouts last_payout returned the OLDEST payout instead of the latest. Frontend (390x844) all requested flows pass: Home storefront (store-card name+rating, 3 banners, 5 bestsellers, all 8 chips, 21 rows on All, Curries=3 + title 'Curries', Veg=14 matches API), ADD on row -> stepper + view-cart-bar count, stepper plus, bestseller-add adds without navigating, bestseller tap -> /item/<id>; Search: placeholder 'Search our menu', no search-mode-tabs, 'biryani' -> 6 dishes, empty state works; Profile: no favourites row; Login -> storefront cart -> checkout -> select saved address -> COD -> place order -> confirmation -> Track 'Waiting for restaurant'. minor.issue: FIXED by tester: last_payout was built via dict comprehension over payouts sorted at DESC, so the last write (the OLDEST payout) won. Reproduced with 2 settlements (showed 10:02:35 instead of 10:03:09). Changed to sort ascending and filter by restaurant_id. partner.py:255

Not atomic: it runs find() and then update_many() by _id without re-checking payout_status, so two concurrent settles could both insert a payout record for the same orders (double payout). Add payout_status != 'paid' to the update_many filter and compute the amount from the matched docs, or use a transaction.
pending_payout/settled_total are summed across all restaurants, not per restaurant. OK for a single restaurant, but note it for the future.

issues: bestseller-add-<id> is 28x28 (hitSlop 6 -> ~40). This is under the 44pt minimum touch target. home.tsx:296

Menu image reuse and irrelevant images: Butter Naan uses the Butter Chicken image, and Dal Makhani/Boondi Raita/Murgh Malai Kebab share the Chicken 65 image. Masala Chaas shows a salad bowl, Sweet Lassi a cake, and Mughlai Egg/Lucknowi Mutton Biryani show pav/buns (seed.py image URLs).

rca_of_issue: last_payout: `{p['rider_id']: p async for p in db.payouts.find().sort('at', -1)}`. In a dict comprehension later items overwrite earlier ones, so with a DESC sort the final value per rider is the oldest payout. Repro: settle the same rider twice and the payouts row shows the first settlement's timestamp. Mitigation applied: sort ascending (latest is written last) and scope to the partner's restaurant.
